brief: A peaceful exploration theme for wandering through an enchanted forest, with gentle melodies and a sense of wonder

spec.description: A gentle, flowing orchestral piece with soft woodwind melodies drifting over lush string pads and delicate harp arpeggios, evoking the feeling of wandering through a sunlit enchanted forest. Shimmering bells and light pizzicato accents add a sense of magic and wonder, while the unhurried tempo breathes life into every step of exploration.
spec.style_hint: Koji Kondo ambient exploration style, The Legend of Zelda overworld feel, Studio Ghibli orchestral warmth

brief: An intense, driving boss battle theme with heavy percussion, dramatic orchestral hits, and an aggressive tempo

spec.description: A ferocious boss battle theme driven by thunderous taiko drums and aggressive orchestral hits, with surging brass stabs and relentless low-end percussion creating an overwhelming sense of danger. Razor-sharp string ostinatos and war-drum rhythms push the intensity to a breaking point, evoking a climactic showdown against a towering enemy.
spec.style_hint: Yoko Shimomura / Masashi Hamauzu dramatic JRPG boss battle orchestral style

brief: A nostalgic 8-bit chiptune town theme reminiscent of classic JRPG menu music, upbeat and catchy

spec.description: Bright and catchy 8-bit chiptune melody with bouncy square wave leads and pulse bass, evoking the warmth of a peaceful JRPG town at dusk. Cheerful arpeggiated accompaniment and a simple triangle wave rhythm section drive an upbeat, loopable groove full of nostalgic charm. Light noise percussion and lively melodic hooks give it an instantly memorable, classic RPG feel.
spec.style_hint: classic NES/SNES era JRPG, Koichi Sugiyama / early Dragon Quest town music style
